of Jun.  E/P is earnings before extraordinary at the last fiscal year end of the prior calendar
year divided by ME at the end of December of the prior year.  Firms with negative or zero
E/P are not included in any portfolio.
Annual returns are from January to December.
Missing data are indicated by -99.99 or -999.
